chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Muhammad ibn Sahl from his father who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who had intercourse with his wife during the month of Ramadan while he was a traveler, and he said: There is no objection.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a traveler to have intercourse with his wife during the day in Ramadan?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Rida (AS), clarifying that a traveler who has broken his fast (ifafara) is permitted to resume marital relations during the day of Ramadan. This highlights the Shia juristic distinction where the traveler's exemption from fasting removes the prohibition of intercourse that applies to residents, reflecting the principle of ease (*rukhas*) in travel. The hadith underscores the practical application of *qasr* and *ifafar* in personal status laws during the holy month.
